scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @wimp/backend" "npm run dev -w @wimp/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wimp/shared && npm run build -w @wimp/backend && npm run build -w @wimp/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wimp/shared && npm run test -w @wimp/backend
scripts.render:build: npm run prisma:generate -w @wimp/backend && npm run build && npm run prisma:migrate -w @wimp/backend && npm run demo:seed
